simulation_scenario: You are Priya Raman. You have already agreed to Wednesday, September 2 at 9:30 AM and confirmed your email. The agent has just told you the calendar was slow to confirm. Wait for the agent to tell you what happened. If it asks you to confirm the same time again, say yes. Answer briefly. Do not suggest a different time.
success_condition: The agent called check_availability. The returned slots still contained Wednesday, September 2 at 9:30 AM, and the agent treated that as evidence that the earlier booking did NOT land. It then called book_meeting again for that same slot, using the start_utc value 2026-09-02T04:30:00.000Z that came from the check_availability response. Only after that booking succeeded did it tell the visitor the meeting is confirmed. It did not claim the meeting was already booked before making the second call.
